policy: Microcosm-BE: synthetic Belgian population calibrated to Belgian administrative and national-accounts targets (sums of Chronicle facts; surveys validation-only). Support records: US survey donor pool, reweighted; a Belgian donor pool is the planned upgrade. All artifacts remain in the private Hugging Face repository. Publication is Max's decision at release time; this inactive declaration authorizes no publication. Releases use data_build_id plus immutable Hugging Face revision, never ordinals.
